method: derived from melody.json (pyin per word) + a frame-level voiced-pyin probe over the sung region: fitted grid offset, pitch-class weights on that grid, chroma_cqt, phrase-final cadences

tonic_estimate.statement: F# is by far the most-sung pitch class (466 voiced frames vs 371 for the runner-up); 'this emoGEE defends me in my bubble' cadences onto F#3, and the whole back half of the song (Safely in a bubble / signifying) orbits ~185-190 Hz

scale_statement: 1 2 3 5 6 b7 in F# — mixolydian with the 4th (B) nearly absent (199 frames, below the 6-degree cut at 287): F# G# A# C# D# E. Major-leaning: A# (major 3rd, 332) clearly outweighs A (minor 3rd, 232).
mode: major/mixolydian-leaning and hand-drawn: the b7 (E) carries the closing question — 'star oh yeah' and the final 'do you see' both land on E3, unresolved; 'signifying my identity' ends on B3 (the missing 4th making its one appearance as a held high note)
